rows.bounds: task-specific small tool profile; no mutation tools

Broad authority, source-upload, persistence, and context cost violate the contract.

sdk_decision.reason: Issue #350 ships schemas, fixtures, gates, and a benchmark, not a production MCP server. Defer the runtime dependency so #351 can evaluate the exact API surface and update supply-chain/inventory.json with an immutable pin if adopted.
sdk_decision.update_policy: Dependabot plus owner review of protocol support, changelog, license, and transitive inventory before each update.
